events.title: UI & Presentation Improvements
events.summary: Revenggie's interface has received a visual overhaul focused on clarity, organization, and overall presentation.Menus, rewards, QTEs, and gameplay information have been reorganized with a cleaner and more consistent UI style, making important information easier to read while preserving the game's visual identity.

events.title: Performance Improvements
events.summary: Improved performance across the game's environments, particularly on lower-end hardware.The result is a smoother experience with no significant changes to the game's visual quality.Thanks again to everyone who tested the demo and shared feedbacks!

events.title: Revenggie Demo - Final Polish & Community Feedback Update
